description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es incrementar la cobertura de abastecimiento de agua y manejo de aguas residuales en comunidades rurales, bajo criterios de sostenibilidad operativa y financiera.
The general objective of the program is to increase the coverage of water supply and wastewater management in rural communities based on operational and financial sustainability criteria.
